<result>## Report — Live rendered Playwright verification, ZimmDrawer header fix (SFCC-831/689)

**Scope note:** I ran exactly the requested test matrix, plus two substitute stories I added myself after discovering the named stories for angle 2-4 can't render what they were meant to test (explained below). I did not touch tsc/vitest/audit/scope/DRY — that's the parent's lane per the brief.

### Selector / DOM strategy

Drawer content renders via a Chakra Portal appended to `document.body` (not inside `#storybook-root`), confirmed via full-body DOM dump. Inside `[role="dialog"]` (the sliding panel = recipe's `content` part), the **first child element** is either:
- the `header` recipe part (`display:flex`, `position: static`, 2 children: an empty/filled `<span>` for `headerTitle` + the close `<button>`) — rendered only when `title` or `boxedHeader` is passed to `ZimmDrawer`, **or**
- the `closeButton` recipe part (`position: absolute`, 1 child: just the `<button>`) — rendered when neither is passed.

I discriminated the two by `getComputedStyle(firstChild).position !== 'absolute'`, which maps directly onto the actual recipe (`closeButton` explicitly sets `position:'absolute'`; `header` never sets `position`). This is repeatable and doesn't depend on Emotion's hashed `css-xxxxx` classnames.

### Finding 1 — 🔴 must-fix, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF (but shares root cause with a dormant pre-existing twin, see Finding 2)

**`prompt` variant header is 72px at tablet/desktop, not the ~92px the fix's own comment claims.**

| Story | Viewport | Measured height | Measured padding (T/B) | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `layout-zimmcountrylanguagemismatch--location` | 390×844 | **80px** | 0px / 0px | ≈80px | ✅ PASS |
| `layout-zimmcountrylanguagemismatch--location` | 834×1112 | **72px** | 24px / 24px | ≈92px (not 72, not 80) | ❌ **FAIL** |
| `layout-zimmcountrylanguagemismatch--location` | 1440×900 | **72px** | 24px / 24px | ≈92px (not 72, not 80) | ❌ **FAIL** |

Root cause, isolated by measuring the close button itself inside the header row at 834px: the button renders at its own intrinsic height of **24px** (`ZimmButton variant="icon"`'s natural size, an svg of 16px inside a 24px hit-target) — not the 44px `DRAWER_HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT` the new comment's arithmetic assumes ("py-24px wrapping a 44px close-icon row ... 92px total"). `DRAWER_HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT` is wired only to the *other* recipe part (`closeButton`, the floating-button branch's own `height:` value, in `zimmDrawer.css.ts`'s `baseStyle.closeButton`) — it is never applied to the button rendered inside the `header` branch (`index.tsx` lines 162-172: the `ZimmButton` there gets no height styling at all). So the real math is 24 (padding-top) + 24 (button, tallest flex child, row centred via `alignItems:'center'`) + 24 (padding-bottom) = **72px**, not 92px. Both `zimmDrawer.css.ts:69-76`'s comment and the `zimmDrawer.css.ts:241-248` `prompt.header` comment assert the 92px figure — both wrong against real rendering.

Net effect: at tablet/desktop the `prompt` header ends up numerically identical to the *old* 72px mobile value it just fixed — coincidentally, not intentionally (mechanism changed: was `minHeight:72,pad:0`; now is `minHeight:unset,pad:24/24` around a 24px row) — while still missing the Figma-cited 92px target by 20px.

This would not have been caught by eyeballing a screenshot: at both 834 and 1440 the close icon still looks reasonably placed, with visible top/bottom margin (screenshots below) — the shortfall is real but not visually glaring on this content (a short one-line heading). This is exactly why the recipe-value test (which only asserts the string `'paddingBlock: HEADER_PADDING_Y'` is present, not a rendered height) and a human glance both miss it.

### Finding 2 — 🟡 should-fix, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM

**The exact same bug shape already exists, dormant, in the pre-existing `xLarge` variant's header override**, which the `prompt` fix explicitly copied ("Same shape as `xLarge`'s own header override below" — `zimmDrawer.css.ts:247`). `xLarge.header` has had `minHeight:'unset'` + `paddingBlock: HEADER_PADDING_Y` with no button-height constraint since before this diff. I did not find any real production consumer of `xLarge` (comment confirms "Cart is a full page today, not a drawer") or of `large`+`title` at desktop width, so this twin is currently inert — but it means the pattern is not a one-off slip, it's a copy of an already-wrong template. If anyone builds the Cart drawer against `xLarge` before this is fixed, it inherits the identical shortfall. (`large`'s own header override is *not* affected — it sets an explicit `minHeight: HEADER_HEIGHT_LARGE` (120px) rather than relying on content height, so it has a real floor and isn't subject to this bug.)

### Finding 3 — 🔴 must-fix on the verification approach itself (not the code), CONFIRMED

**`elements-zimmdrawer--small`, `--large`, `--x-large` cannot verify this diff at all** — none of them pass `title` or `boxedHeader`, so all three render the `closeButton` (floating) part, not `header`. `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` is never applied to anything visible in these three stories, before or after this diff.

| Story | Viewport | First-child `position` | Renders `header`? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elements-zimmdrawer--small` | 390×844 | `absolute` | No |
| `elements-zimmdrawer--large` | 390×844 | `absolute` | No |
| `elements-zimmdrawer--x-large` | 390×844 | `absolute` | No |

I checked whether this makes the claim in the fix's own comment untestable or actually false for real consumers, by grepping real (non-story) `ZimmDrawer` usages:
- `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer/index.tsx:61-68` passes `size="small"` **with** `title={drawerTitle}` → real header-row path, genuinely affected by `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE`.
- `zimmPdpDrawer/index.tsx:51` passes neither `title` nor `boxedHeader` → floating close button, never touches `header` at all (Find in Boutique/PDP tab drawer are therefore **not** affected by this constant, contrary to what the fix's comment lists them as).

Since the literal requested stories can't test the claim, I ran two substitute stories that do exercise the real `header` path with the same `size`, and are structurally closer to the real `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer` usage than the requested ones:

| Story (substitute) | Viewport | Measured height | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `elements-zimmdrawer--with-title-small-drawer` (proxy for "small") | 390×844 | **80px** | ≈80px, not 72 | ✅ PASS |
| `elements-zimmdrawer--with-title-large` (proxy for "large") | 390×844 | **80px** | ≈80px, not 72 | ✅ PASS |

No title-bearing `xLarge` story exists anywhere in `index.stories.tsx` — **untestable via any existing Storybook story**, not just via the requested one. Given Finding 2, this gap is worth closing before `xLarge` gets a real consumer, not after.

### Screenshots (read back, not just captured)

- `/tmp/a5-shots/location-390.png` — close X clear of edges, comfortable vertical centring in the 80px band, no overlap with heading text below. Visually clean.
- `/tmp/a5-shots/location-834.png` — close X has visible top/bottom margin; heading starts well clear of the header row. Visually looks fine *despite* being 20px short of spec — confirms a screenshot alone would not have caught Finding 1.
- `/tmp/a5-shots/location-1440.png` — same as 834, proportionally.
- `/tmp/a5-shots/small-390.png` — this is the **pre-existing, unaffected** floating-close-button chrome (top:40px/right:32px inset from `INSET_COMPACT`), not the `header` part. Text and X don't overlap, but this screenshot proves nothing about the diff under test.
- `/tmp/a5-shots/proxy-small-with-title-390.png` — "SIGN IN" title and close X both clearly centred in the 80px band, clean gap before body content. This is the real visual confirmation that the mobile fix works correctly for the actual real-world consumer shape.
- Also captured, not required to visually re-read (measured geometry was byte-identical to `small-390`): `/tmp/a5-shots/large-390.png`, `/tmp/a5-shots/xlarge-390.png`. Also captured: `/tmp/a5-shots/proxy-large-with-title-390.png`.

### What I could not test

- No real `xLarge` consumer and no title-bearing `xLarge` story exist, so Finding 2's live-rendered impact on `xLarge` specifically is reasoned from the identical code shape, not independently measured — flagging this as PLAUSIBLE-not-CONFIRMED for `xLarge` itself (Finding 1's 72-vs-92 mechanism is CONFIRMED on `prompt`; carrying it to `xLarge` is inference from identical code, not a separate measurement I ran).
- I did not check `zimmAuthDrawerContent`/PDP "Find in Boutique" beyond the one `zimmPdpDrawer` grep hit above — if there's a second, different real consumer of `size="small"`/`"large"` with `boxedHeader` (rather than `title`) elsewhere in the app, I didn't chase it down; the two consumers I found were sufficient to establish the story-selection problem in Finding 3.</result>

content.text:
## Testing report — Step A5 (SFCC-831/689), `zimmDrawer.css.ts` header-height fix

**Scale line:** The task specified two angle-groups (static scope/build-gate confirmation, and live-rendered geometry) — I ran both myself directly for the cheap/deterministic half (git diff, test-file read, grep, `tsc`/`vitest`/`audit:tokens`, consumer mapping, ticket cross-check) and dispatched one fork sub-agent for the genuinely tool-heavy half (Playwright across 4 stories × up to 3 widths + screenshots), then independently re-ran its most consequential measurement myself from scratch before trusting it. Of the standing 10-angle framework, I dropped 6 as structurally vacuous for a single-file, zero-new-JSX, zero-new-import CSS-constant diff: tokens semantic-intent (no colour tokens touched), structure, imports, accessibility, recipe-state/hover-gating, stacking-context (no interactive part, hover-reveal, or overlay pattern introduced), story-interactivity-fidelity, and React-logic-correctness (no stateful logic — pure recipe values). I ran build gates, DRY, styling conformance, ticket/blast-radius cross-check, and real rendered-layout verification, plus one extra check the brief didn't ask for but that falsification required: independently mapping every real `ZimmDrawer` consumer against the diff's own blast-radius claim, since taking that claim at face value would have missed a real defect.

---

### 1. Scope/diff confirmation (static) — CLEAN, with one scope note

`git diff` confirms `zimmDrawer.css.ts` has exactly the two changes described: `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` `'72px'`→`'80px'` (line 76) and the new `prompt.header` override (lines 241-254). `zimmDrawer.css.test.ts` — read in full — has zero assertions on `header`/`minHeight`/`paddingBlock` (every test targets `content` or `parts`), so this value change couldn't have broken-then-been-"fixed" against a stale test. Grep confirms no other file hardcodes `72px` for a drawer header, and `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` cannot be imported elsewhere — it's an unexported local `const`.

🔵 **Scope note, not a defect of A5:** `git status` also shows `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` modified and a whole untracked `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/` component directory. This is **not** part of A5 — the diff to `index.ts` is only the new component's theme registration, and the component's own `index.test.tsx` (11 tests) already passes as part of the 79/1187 baseline, confirming it's finished, already-tested prior-step work sitting uncommitted in the tree, not scope creep by this step.

### 2. Build gates — CLEAN, exact baseline match

- `npx tsc --noEmit` → clean, 0 errors. Matches baseline.
- `npm run test` → **79 test files passed, 1187 tests passed, 0 failures.** Exact match to baseline.
- `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` → **3 unacknowledged** (`footer.css.ts:20`, `zimmAuthDrawerContent.css.ts:58`, `zimmDrawerShared.ts:12`) — exact match to baseline, none newly introduced.

🔵 **Note, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM** — `zimmDrawer.css.ts:76`'s new `'80px'` literal shows up in the **acknowledged** list, but not because its own comment (lines 69-75) contains an exception marker — it doesn't. It rides on the `audit-allow` comment attached to the unrelated `HEADER_HEIGHT_LARGE` constant 9 lines above (line 67), because the audit script's rule is "walk up to the nearest *blank* line" (`scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs:119-122`) and lines 60-76 are one unbroken block with no blank line separating the two constants. Today this is harmless (exit code 0 either way), but it's fragile: a future formatting pass that inserts a blank line between them would newly surface this as a real unacknowledged finding with no code change at all. Same risk shape applies anywhere a new constant is typed directly under an existing `audit-allow` block without its own blank-line separation.

### 3. Blast-radius / consumer mapping — one 🔵 finding against the diff's own comment, one correction to my own brief

I mapped every real (non-story, non-test) `ZimmDrawer` usage rather than trusting either the diff's comment or my own instructions:

| Consumer | `size=` | Passes `title`/`boxedHeader`? | Actually touches `header` part? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer/index.tsx:61-68` | `small` | `title={drawerTitle}` ✅ | **Yes** — genuinely affected |
| `product-detail/index.tsx` "Find in Boutique" (~line 1195) | `small` | neither | **No** — floating close button only |
| `zimmPdpDrawer/index.tsx:51` | `mobile`/`tablet`/`large` | neither | **No** — floating close button only |
| `zimmCountryLanguageMismatch/index.tsx:172` | `prompt` | `boxedHeader` ✅ | **Yes** — genuinely affected |

🔵 **Note, CONFIRMED, ONE-OFF:** the diff's own new comment (`zimmDrawer.css.ts:73-74`) lists "(Wishlist, Login, Find in Boutique, Cookies, Notify Me)" as affected consumers. Of these, only Wishlist/Login (one component, two content states) is real and actually affected. "Find in Boutique" is named but passes neither `title` nor `boxedHeader`, so it never renders `header` at all — unaffected. Cookies/Notify Me don't exist as built consumers yet (grepped, none found). **Correction to my own brief:** the task I was given also asserted "zimmPdpDrawer's tab drawer" collapses to this baseStyle value — confirmed false by reading `zimmPdpDrawer/index.tsx:51` directly: it passes neither `title` nor `boxedHeader`, so `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` has zero effect on it.

### 4. Styling conformance & DRY — CLEAN

`var(--zimm-scale-xl)` used correctly for `HEADER_PADDING_Y`, reused (not retyped) between `xLarge.header` and the new `prompt.header` — single source, no drift risk. Explicit `@media (min-width: ${breakpoints.md})` used, not Chakra array shorthand, matching the established pattern. `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` is declared once, used once (`baseStyle.header`), inherited everywhere else — no duplicate literal.

### 5. Real rendered-layout verification — 🔴 must-fix, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM

This is the substantial finding. My fork sub-agent measured the `prompt` header via real Playwright/Chromium and found it does **not** reach the ~92px the fix's own comment claims at tablet/desktop. Given the significance, I did not just trust the sub-agent's report — I independently re-ran the measurement myself from scratch and read the underlying render source directly.

**My own independent re-measurement** (`layout-zimmcountrylanguagemismatch--location` @ 834×1112, fresh Playwright script, not reusing the fork's):
```json
{ "position": "static", "height": 72, "paddingTop": "24px", "paddingBottom": "24px", "buttonHeight": 24, "childCount": 2 }
```
72px, not 92px — confirms the fork's number exactly.

**Mechanism, confirmed by reading `index.tsx` myself:** the `header` branch (`index.tsx:162-172`) renders `<ZimmButton variant="icon" .../>` as a bare flex child with **no height applied to it anywhere** — `ZimmButton`'s `icon` variant (`zimmButton.css.ts:187-210`) sets no height itself. Compare the `closeButton` branch (`index.tsx:174-176`): the identical `ZimmButton` there is wrapped in `<chakra.div sx={closeButtonStyles}>`, and `closeButtonStyles` (`baseStyle.closeButton`, `zimmDrawer.css.ts:135-142`) explicitly sets `height: DRAWER_HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT` (44px) on that wrapper. `DRAWER_HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT` was only ever wired to the `closeButton` branch (its own doc comment in `zimmDrawerShared.ts` says as much) — the `header` branch never had it, before or after this diff. So the real math is 24 (padding-top) + 24 (button's own unconstrained height) + 24 (padding-bottom) = **72px** — coincidentally landing on the exact old mobile value this diff was fixing, not the ~92px its comment (`zimmDrawer.css.ts:244-248`) states.

**Consequence:** the `prompt` drawer's tablet/desktop header — the ZimmCountryLanguageMismatch prompt, this ticket's own headline feature — is unchanged from before the fix at those widths, despite the diff claiming to have added the missing override. A screenshot alone does not catch this: `/tmp/a5-shots/location-834.png` and `location-1440.png` (read back and visually confirmed by me) show a close icon with visible top/bottom margin that "looks right" — the shortfall is real but not visually glaring on short single-line copy.

**UNIFORM:** `xLarge.header` (`zimmDrawer.css.ts:266-271`) has the byte-identical `minHeight:'unset', paddingBlock: HEADER_PADDING_Y` shape — the new `prompt.header`'s own comment says it was modelled on it ("Same shape as `xLarge`'s own header override below"). It carries the identical latent defect today, dormant only because no real consumer or title/boxedHeader-bearing story exists for `xLarge` yet (confirmed: no such story in `index.stories.tsx`).

**Mobile case (below `md`) is fine, confirmed working:** the actual `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` 72→80 bump is real and correct. My brief's named stories `elements-zimmdrawer--small`/`--large`/`--x-large` turned out to be the wrong probes (see below), so the fork substituted `elements-zimmdrawer--with-title-small-drawer` and `--with-title-large` (the only existing stories that pass `title`, matching how the real `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer` consumer calls `ZimmDrawer`) — both measured 80px at 390px, and I confirmed this visually via the screenshots. `layout-zimmcountrylanguagemismatch--location` at 390px also measured 80px, padding 0/0, matching `baseStyle.header`'s `paddingBlock: 0`.

🟡 **Should-fix on test/story coverage, CONFIRMED, UNIFORM:** `elements-zimmdrawer--small`, `--large`, and `--x-large` (the literal stories named in my brief) render `OpenDrawerExample`, which passes only `aria-label` — never `title` or `boxedHeader` — so per `index.tsx:162` (`title || boxedHeader ? ... : ...`) all three render only the floating `closeButton` part and **cannot exercise `header`/`HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` at all**, before or after this diff. This means the "obvious" story for verifying a consumer's header currently doesn't; it's a real, repeatable trap for a future test/verification pass, and it's total for `xLarge` (no title-bearing story exists there at any size).

### Visual checkpoint brief

| What to check | Figma node (as cited in code) | Expected | Measured | How verified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` header height @ 390px (mobile) | 40007204:186159 | 80px | **80px** ✅ | Playwright `getBoundingClientRect()` on the discriminated header div |
| `prompt` header height @ 834px (tablet) | 40007204:186134 | 92px *(per code comment — could not independently confirm against real Figma, see below)* | **72px** ❌ | Playwright, independently re-run twice (fork + my own script) |
| `prompt` header height @ 1440px (desktop) | 40002218:52408 | 92px *(same caveat)* | **72px** ❌ | Playwright |
| `prompt` header padding-top/bottom @ ≥md | (same nodes) | 24px/24px | **24px/24px** ✅ | `getComputedStyle()` — padding itself is correct; the button/row inside it is short |
| Close-icon vertical centring @ tablet/desktop | (same nodes) | Centred, visible margin | Visually centred in screenshot, but the containing row is 20px short of spec | Screenshot read (`location-834.png`, `location-1440.png`) |
| `small` header height @ 390px (proxy: `WithTitleSmallDrawer`, real consumer = Wishlist/Login) | not cited in file | 80px | **80px** ✅ | Playwright + screenshot |
| `large` header height @ 390px (proxy: `WithTitleLarge`) | not cited in file | 80px | **80px** ✅ | Playwright + screenshot |
| `xLarge` header height, any width | not cited in file | Unknown — likely 72px by the same code shape as `prompt`, unconfirmed | **Cannot check — no story exists with `title`/`boxedHeader` at `size="xLarge"`** | N/A — open gap, not a row I could fill |

---

### What I tried to falsify

- Tried to find a second file touched by this step beyond `zimmDrawer.css.ts` — found two, but traced both to already-tested prior-step work, not A5.
- Tried to find a pre-existing test that would have caught the header height at all — confirmed none exists (`zimmDrawer.css.test.ts` has zero header assertions), which is exactly why the live-rendered check mattered.
- Tried to take the diff's own "92px total" arithmetic at face value and instead re-derived it from the actual render path — it failed, and I reproduced the failure myself independently rather than accepting the sub-agent's word for it.
- Tried to take my own task brief's consumer list at face value (Wishlist, PDP tab drawer, Find in Boutique, Cookies, Notify Me) and instead grepped and read every real usage — one named consumer (PDP tab drawer) turned out not to be affected at all.
- Tried the literal stories named in the brief (`small`/`large`/`x-large`) before accepting they couldn't test what they were asked to test, then found working substitutes and confirmed those instead of reporting "untestable" and stopping.

### What I could not verify

- **Figma ground truth.** No Figma file URL exists anywhere in this repo (`.docs/`, `overrides/`) — searched exhaustively, zero hits. The node IDs cited in the code comments (`40007204:186159`, `40002218:52408`, `40007204:186134`) could not be independently opened or measured against a real Figma file. This means I cannot confirm 80px/92px are the *correct* targets, only that the code fails to hit its own stated 92px target regardless of whether 92 itself is right.
- **`xLarge` at any width, live.** No production consumer, no title/boxedHeader-bearing story — genuinely unverifiable through any existing surface, not just the one I happened to check.
- **Whether `small`'s own desktop header should also be 92px.** The new `prompt.header` comment cites Figma's "Desktop Small" node as its 92px source — the same node name the file's own header table (lines 8-13) assigns to the `small` variant. `small.header` has no override at any width and stays at 80px (baseStyle) above `md` too. Whether that's a second, separate gap or intentional divergence, I could not resolve from code or docs alone — flagging rather than guessing.

### What Marcel is missing

The `small` variant's own header has no `@media (min-width: md)` override at all, so it renders `HEADER_HEIGHT_MOBILE` (now 80px) at *every* width including desktop — for `zimmWishlistAuthDrawer`, the one real consumer, that means its desktop header height silently changed 72→80 as a side effect of this "mobile-only" fix, and if Figma's Desktop-Small spec really is 92px (the same node the new `prompt.header` comment cites), `small`'s desktop header is a second, pre-existing gap between it and the same target this diff was chasing for `prompt` — worth deciding whether that's in scope for a follow-up before someone assumes `small` is "done" because A5 touched an adjacent constant.
